draft.headline: Meta launched personal AI agent Muse for UK adults to assist with everyday tasks.
draft.threads_post:
Meta launched its personal AI agent Muse for UK adults on Tuesday.

It is the first AI agent product from a Big Tech company to launch in the UK. The tool is designed to assist users with everyday tasks, while UK regulators watch the rollout carefully.

Would you trust an AI agent with your daily tasks?
